privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what {{app}} collects, why, and the choices you have. {{app}} is software that barber shops and ladies salons use to run their day: queue, sales, stock, staff, payroll and tax.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: {{company}} (“we”) provides {{app}}, the app and the website. For your account and how you use {{app}}, we decide how your data is used: we are the “controller”. For the details a salon keeps about its own customers and staff, the salon is the controller: it decides what is recorded and why, and we store and process them for it, on its instructions, under the data processing terms in our terms of use.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body:
• Your account: your name, email address and password (kept only as a secure hash). If you continue with Google, Google gives us your name and email address.
• What salons enter: services and prices, sales and receipts, expenses, suppliers and purchases, stock, cash counts, customers’ names, phone numbers and visits, staff names, attendance and pay, and documents such as licences and photos of receipts.
• This device: a notification token if you allow notifications. Your language and remembered sign-in stay on the device.
We use no advertising trackers and we never sell personal data.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Only to run the service: to sign you in, save and show your salon’s records, send the notifications you switch on, produce receipts, reports and backups, keep the service secure, answer support requests and meet legal duties such as keeping tax records.

basis.title: Why we may use it (legal bases)
basis.body:
• To provide the service you or your salon signed up for (a contract).
• To meet legal duties, such as keeping tax and financial records (a legal obligation).
• To keep the service secure, prevent misuse and fix faults, which is in our and our users’ legitimate interest; you can object to this.
• For phone notifications and any optional messages, because you agreed; you can turn them off at any time (consent).
In Brazil these are the matching legal bases of the LGPD (article 7).

where.title: Where it is kept
where.body:
Your data is stored with Supabase (database, sign-in and file storage) in South Korea. The website and app are delivered by Vercel from servers close to you. Emails go through our email provider, notifications to phones through Expo and Apple or Google, and Google handles “Continue with Google”. These providers process data only for us, under data processing terms, and must keep it confidential and secure.
The European Union and the United Kingdom recognise South Korea as protecting personal data adequately. Where a provider handles data in a country without such recognition, such as the United States, the transfer is covered by the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses with the UK addendum and, for Brazil, by the safeguards the LGPD allows, such as standard contractual clauses.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.body: Only the providers above, to run the service, and public authorities when the law requires it. Inside a salon, what each person sees follows their role; for example, a cashier cannot see payroll. Receipts you send by WhatsApp or print are shared by you.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.body: Your account details stay until you delete your account. A salon’s financial records (sales, tax, expenses, purchases and payroll) are kept for at least five years, or longer where the salon’s country requires it, even after an account is deleted or a salon closes. After that they are deleted.

rights.title: Your choices and rights
rights.body:
• You can see and correct your details in the app. Owners can export all their salon’s data at any time (More → Backup & recovery).
• You can delete your account in the app (More → Delete my account): your sign-in and name are removed straight away; records the law requires us to keep are kept as described above.
• If you are in the European Union, the United Kingdom or Brazil you can also: get a copy of your data and know how it is used; have it corrected or erased; restrict or object to its use; receive it in a format you can move; and withdraw your consent at any time (this does not affect what was done before). In Brazil you can also ask whether we process your data, have unnecessary data anonymised or blocked, and know who we share it with. The UAE Personal Data Protection Law and similar laws in other countries give you comparable rights.
• To use these rights, write to the address below. We answer within one month, and within 15 days for a full copy of your data in Brazil. We may ask you to confirm who you are. We do not make decisions about people by automated means alone.
• A salon’s customers and staff should contact the salon first, as it controls those records; we help it answer.
• You can also complain to a data protection authority: in the European Union the one where you live or work, in the United Kingdom the Information Commissioner’s Office (ico.org.uk), and in Brazil the ANPD (gov.br/anpd).

cookies.title: Cookies and device storage
cookies.body: The app and the website keep only what they need on your device: your sign-in and settings such as your language and salon type. We use no advertising or analytics cookies and do not track you on other sites.

security.title: How we protect it
security.body: Connections are encrypted, passwords and PINs are kept only as secure hashes, every salon’s records are kept apart, and access inside a salon follows each person’s role. Money records cannot be deleted or quietly changed: every correction leaves a history.

children.title: Children
children.body: The service is for businesses and people aged 18 or over. We do not knowingly collect children’s data through it.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use {{app}}, the app and the website. By creating an account or using the service you agree to them.

service.title: The service
service.body: {{app}} helps barber shops and ladies salons run their day: queue and bookings, sales and receipts, stock and purchases, expenses, cash closing, staff and payroll, licence reminders, tax and reports. It is a tool: you remain responsible for your business, your records, your tax returns and your staff’s pay.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: Owners create the salon and their team’s logins, and are responsible for how they are used. Keep passwords and PINs private and tell us if you think an account has been misused. You must be 18 or over and allowed to act for the business.

plans.title: Plans and payment
plans.body: Setting up is free. Using the features (queue, sales and the rest) needs an active plan, charged per branch per month at the price shown on our website. Plans are paid in advance, switch on when the payment is received and do not renew by themselves. Paid months are not refunded, except where the law requires. If a plan ends your data stays: you can still sign in, view it and export it.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Your salon’s data belongs to you. You allow us to store and process it only to provide the service. You are responsible for being allowed to record your customers’ and staff’s details (for example, their agreement to receive WhatsApp receipts). You can export it at any time.

processing.title: Your customers’ and staff’s data (data processing terms)
processing.body:
When your salon records its customers’ and staff’s details, your salon is the controller and we process them for you. These terms are our data processing agreement (GDPR and UK GDPR article 28; LGPD article 39):
• We process the data only to provide the service and on your instructions — how you use the app is your instruction — unless the law requires otherwise.
• Everyone who works on the service must keep it confidential.
• We keep it secure as described in our privacy policy: encrypted connections, each salon’s records kept apart and access by role.
• We use the providers named in our privacy policy (sub-processors) under terms that protect the data as these do. We tell owners in the app before adding or replacing one, and you may object.
• We help you answer your customers’ and staff’s requests (copies, corrections, deletions) and with any assessment the law requires.
• We tell you without undue delay, and within 48 hours of learning of it, if a breach affects your salon’s data.
• When you stop, you can export all your data; we delete it after the periods the law requires us to keep it.
• We give you the information you need to show these terms are kept, and allow reasonable audits.
You confirm you have a lawful basis to record your customers’ and staff’s details and have told them about it.

fairUse.title: Fair use
fairUse.body: Do not use the service for anything unlawful, to send spam, to reach other salons’ data, or to disrupt or copy the service.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: We work to keep the service running and your data safe, but cannot promise it will never be interrupted, so keep your own backups (More → Backup & recovery). We may improve or change features, and will tell owners in advance of a change that reduces what a paid plan includes.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: The service is provided as it is. As far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect losses such as lost profit, and our total liability is limited to what you paid us in the three months before the claim. Figures, reports and tax summaries are aids: check them with your accountant before filing.

ending.title: Ending
ending.body: You can stop at any time by deleting your account in the app. We may suspend an account that breaks these terms or is not paid, after telling the owner when we reasonably can.

law.title: Law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates as applied in the Emirate of Dubai, and the courts of Dubai decide any dispute.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms; the date above shows the current version. Using the service after a change means the new terms apply.
